title: Bo Nix says Jaylen Waddle brings an element of explosiveness that the Broncos have lacked

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bo Nix says Jaylen Waddle brings an element of explosiveness that the Broncos have lacked
sources.description: The Denver Broncos’ offense over the past two seasons has been good, but it has lacked that something extra to elevate it to a great offense. The team identified this as an issue this offseason and went out and acquired explosive wide receiver Jaylen Waddle in a blockbuster trade. On Tuesday, the media was able […]
